---
id: GM-21
title: Review actions
type: feature
status: backlog
priority: high
estimate: 4d
remaining: 4d
milestone: M4
depends_on: [GM-20, GM-13]
---

Answer, comment on lines and give verdicts. See [[Experience#pull-requests]].

- [ ] Reply to the discussion, a topic or a code range
- [ ] Comment on lines: tap and drag line numbers; new topic or add to one; suggestion as an edit of the lines; optional to-do
- [ ] Approve, Request changes, Withdraw approval, Request review, naming the source's commit
- [ ] New pull request from a branch; Close, Reopen, and Mark merged once the target has every commit of the source (D10)
- [ ] Replies on a pull request whose file is on the source branch: commit onto that branch's tree, named on the button, only branches the remote has, never forced (D9)
